examples.subject: Urgent: Your payment failed
examples.body:
Dear Customer,

We were unable to process your recent payment. Your account will be suspended unless you update your payment information immediately.

Please click the link below to verify your account details:
http://secure-payments-update.xyz/verify

Failure to act within 24 hours will result in service termination.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Best regards,
Billing Team
